caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet-like head covering shown in profile, with the larger section on the left and the opening facing to the right. The exterior of the bonnet is a deep purple color, shaded to suggest volume and texture, while the lining along the opening is a pale green with a diamond and plaid pattern made up of intersecting lines in green and yellow tones. The lining also has small circular metallic elements spaced evenly along the edge, possibly indicating rivets or buttons. Two sets of metal rods or decorative pins with rounded ends extend diagonally from the lower edge of the purple section, crossing near the bottom and securing the fabric. Two long, narrow ribbons attached at the bottom back edge are visible, colored in light pink and subtle green lines. Below the bonnet, there is a small rectangular swatch featuring a repeated motif of pink triangles, pink rectangles, and thin vertical green lines inside a border of vertical pink lines, suggesting a related textile pattern or decorative trim. The objects are centered on a plain, off-white background, enclosed within a faint rectangular border.
title: Bonnet
